package svcconfig // import "github.com/airencracken/comfylib/svcconfig"

func ParseShellValue(raw string) (string, error)

func ReadSystemdEnvironment(unitPath, key string) (value string, found bool, err error)

func ScanSystemdService(unitPath string, visit func(name, value, path string, line int) error) error

type Paths struct {
	Name string

	Prefix string

	OpenRCConfig string

	OpenRCInstalled bool

	OpenRCActive bool

	SystemdUnit string

	SystemdActive bool

	DefaultDataDir string
	// contains filtered or unexported fields
}

func Detect(app, defaultDataDir string) Paths

func (p Paths) Account(defaultUser string) (user, group string, managed bool, err error)

func (p Paths) DataDir(envKey string) (string, error)

func (p Paths) Managed() bool

func (p Paths) Setting(key, fallback, what string) (string, error)

func (p Paths) Settings(keys ...string) (map[string]string, error)
